breathEffect.reason: The action supplies its own body motion; no extra breathing deformation during locomotion, laughter, flight or waking.

name: Running_Animation
description: Right-facing run with a stable horizontal head anchor, alternating supports and two flight phases.
notes: Original eight complete drawings translated by integer pixels using the midpoint of the warm flame-head bounds. The old neck detector selected arm pixels in flight, producing 46–52 px horizontal jumps. Vertical placement, original RGBA, connected anatomy, scale and airborne clearance are preserved. Both four-pose steps use matching contact/compression/passing/flight exposures of 80/65/65/110 ms (640 ms loop). No body slicing, repainting, morphing or added breathing transform. This registration repair does not redraw residual pose-to-pose anatomy changes. Scale v6: one fixed whole-character transform per clip, matched to the standing-idle median opaque head silhouette area. It includes eyes/mouth, so blinking does not change the scale estimate. No frame-specific scaling, head/body cuts, or pose-height normalization. Grounded contacts remain y592; flight clearance is transformed about the shared root. Pose projection, breathing and original drawing proportions remain intact.
